outputs.L3:
The sheet-like article includes a plurality of absorbent units. Each absorbent unit is formed from an elongated base portion and water-absorbent polymer particles that are fixed to one surface of the elongated base portion.

The absorbent units are arranged such that the longitudinal directions of the respective elongated base portions are oriented in the same direction. In the state before liquid absorption, the water-absorbent polymer particles are located inward of both lateral side edge portions of the elongated base portion. That is, the particles do not extend beyond the opposite side edges of the base portion prior to absorbing liquid.

When liquid is absorbed by the water-absorbent polymer particles, the particles swell and expand outwardly so as to extend beyond the lateral side edge portions of the elongated base portion. As a result of this liquid absorption and swelling, the position of the elongated base portion in the thickness direction of the sheet-like article changes from its position before liquid absorption.
outputs.L4:
A sheet-like absorbent article is provided that is capable of efficiently absorbing and retaining bodily fluids or other liquids while maintaining a thin, flexible structure. The absorbent article includes a plurality of absorbent units arranged side by side so as to extend in a longitudinal direction of the article. Each absorbent unit has an elongated base portion, such as a strip-shaped sheet or web, and a plurality of water-absorbent polymer particles fixed to one surface of the base portion.

Before liquid absorption, the water-absorbent polymer particles are disposed at positions located inward of the side edges of the corresponding base portion in the width direction. In this state, the absorbent units can be compactly arranged, and the article can remain thin, soft, and easy to conform to the body or to an object to which it is applied. The polymer particles may be fixed to the base portion by an adhesive, a binder, heat bonding, mechanical entanglement, or another suitable fixing means that allows the particles to remain in place during use.

When liquid reaches the absorbent article, the water-absorbent polymer particles absorb the liquid and swell. As the particles swell, they expand outward in the width direction and project beyond the side edges of the base portion. This swelling causes the base portion to be displaced or shifted in the thickness direction of the absorbent article. As a result, spaces or channels can be formed between adjacent absorbent units or between portions of the sheet structure, thereby promoting liquid diffusion, temporary liquid storage, and continued absorption.

Because the absorbent polymer particles move from an inwardly positioned state to an expanded state extending beyond the side edges of the base portion, the article can combine good initial thinness with high absorption capacity after wetting. The displacement of the base portions in the thickness direction also helps reduce blockage of liquid flow that can occur when absorbent particles swell in a confined space. Accordingly, the absorbent article can more effectively take in liquid, distribute it along the longitudinal direction, and retain it within the swollen polymer particles.

The absorbent article may be used in various products requiring liquid absorption, including disposable diapers, sanitary napkins, incontinence pads, absorbent sheets, medical absorbent materials, and packaging or industrial liquid-absorbing sheets. The arrangement of the longitudinal absorbent units provides flexibility and conformability, while the controlled swelling behavior of the polymer particles improves liquid-handling performance, absorption efficiency, and wearer or user comfort.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract describing a sheet-like absorbent article made of multiple longitudinal absorbent units with polymer particles that swell beyond the side edges after absorbing liquid.
counterfactuals.output: A sheet-like absorbent article comprises a plurality of elongated absorbent units arranged side-by-side in a longitudinal direction to form a flexible absorbent sheet. Each absorbent unit includes a liquid-permeable covering layer and an absorbent core containing water-absorbent polymer particles. The absorbent units are separated from one another at least in part by longitudinal boundary regions that permit bending or folding of the article while maintaining liquid-holding capacity. Upon absorption of an aqueous liquid, the polymer particles swell and expand laterally such that swollen portions of the absorbent material project outwardly beyond side edges of the corresponding absorbent unit, thereby increasing the effective absorbent volume and promoting retention of liquid within the article. The configuration provides a thin, conformable absorbent sheet before use and enhanced absorbency and leakage resistance after wetting.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a technical description for an invention involving an absorbent sheet, long base portions, and water-absorbent polymer particles fixed on one face, including how the particles are positioned before and after liquid absorption.
counterfactuals.output:
An absorbent sheet comprises a plurality of elongated base portions arranged in a sheet-like configuration. Each elongated base portion has a longitudinal direction, a width direction intersecting the longitudinal direction, a first face, and a second face opposite the first face. Water-absorbent polymer particles are fixed to at least one face of the elongated base portions, preferably to only the first face, by an adhesive, binder, thermal bonding layer, or other fixing means.

Before liquid absorption, the water-absorbent polymer particles are disposed on the first face of each elongated base portion in a predetermined distribution. The particles may be arranged intermittently or continuously along the longitudinal direction of the base portion, and may be positioned so that adjacent particles are spaced apart from one another. In this state, the particles are held in a substantially non-swollen condition and project from the first face while remaining fixed thereto. Spaces are provided between neighboring particles and/or between neighboring elongated base portions, thereby permitting liquid to enter and move through the sheet.

When liquid is supplied to the absorbent sheet, the liquid reaches the water-absorbent polymer particles through the spaces between the particles and the elongated base portions. The particles absorb the liquid and swell while remaining fixed on the first face of the base portions. After absorption, the swollen particles increase in volume and extend outwardly from the first face. The swelling causes the particles to occupy at least part of the spaces that existed before absorption, while the fixation to the base portions prevents substantial migration or aggregation of the particles within the sheet.

In one embodiment, the elongated base portions are formed as strip-shaped fibrous bodies, nonwoven strips, film strips, or composite strips. The base portions may extend substantially parallel to one another, may be connected to one another at intervals, or may be incorporated into a carrier sheet. The water-absorbent polymer particles may be superabsorbent polymer particles including crosslinked polyacrylic acid salt, starch-acrylic acid graft polymer, or other hydrogel-forming absorbent materials.

By fixing the water-absorbent polymer particles to one face of the elongated base portions, the absorbent sheet maintains particle position before liquid absorption and controls the location of swollen gel after liquid absorption. This structure reduces gel blocking, improves liquid permeability, and enables efficient use of the water-absorbent polymer particles while preserving flexibility of the sheet.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe an absorbent article component using reference numerals: sheet-like article (1), long base portion (2), side edge portions (2s), polymer particles (3), and absorbent units (4), emphasizing the swelling behavior when liquid is absorbed.
counterfactuals.output:
The absorbent article component includes a sheet-like article **(1)** having a long base portion **(2)**. The long base portion **(2)** includes side edge portions **(2s)** extending along its length.

Polymer particles **(3)** are disposed in association with the base portion **(2)** to form absorbent units **(4)**. Each absorbent unit **(4)** is configured to take in and retain liquid. When liquid is absorbed, the polymer particles **(3)** swell, causing the corresponding absorbent units **(4)** to increase in volume.

As the absorbent units **(4)** swell, they can rise or expand relative to the sheet-like article **(1)**, improving liquid retention and helping to inhibit leakage. The swelling behavior of the polymer particles **(3)** also allows the absorbent units **(4)** to conform to the absorbed liquid volume while maintaining the overall sheet-like form of the article **(1)**.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4

counterfactuals.prompt: Create an English patent abstract from the following concept: absorbent units with water-absorbent polymer particles are arranged longitudinally; particles initially sit inside the side edges of a base strip but swell outward past the edges and shift the base strip in the thickness direction.
counterfactuals.output: An absorbent article includes a base strip extending in a longitudinal direction and a plurality of absorbent units arranged along the longitudinal direction. Each absorbent unit includes water-absorbent polymer particles disposed on the base strip at positions inward of opposite side edges of the base strip in an initial state. Upon absorption of liquid, the water-absorbent polymer particles swell outward beyond the side edges of the base strip and displace the base strip in a thickness direction. This configuration enables controlled expansion of the absorbent units and improves liquid absorption capacity while promoting three-dimensional deformation of the base strip.
